verdict.rationale: Shopify ships extensive first-party documented public APIs (Admin GraphQL API, Storefront API, webhooks, versioned release schedule, CLI, GraphiQL explorer, dev stores) enabling programmatic control of stores/apps/storefronts, corroborated by shopify.dev docs across many surfaces. Community feedback (comm-8, comm-9, comm-12) raises real friction points (poor docs experience, missing refund endpoint, account-gated API access) that keep this from a perfect score. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation that the API is easy/reliable to drive end-to-end, and resolution of documented functional gaps like refunds not being exposed via API.
